verdict.line: You lose if you eat a charged W (Path Maker) into all-in; you win any trade where you bait Q (Ntofo Strikes) or his W cooldown into your W (Riposte).

brief.thesis: Neither champion has a lane-phase gap to exploit — this is decided by who plays their cooldowns better. K'Sante's threat is entirely tied to his W (Path Maker) charge-and-dash stun and his 2-stack Q (Ntofo Strikes) pull; whenever both are down, he has no way to lock you down and Fiora's Q (Lunge) double-dash just wins the exchange.

theirWindow.when: Q stacked to 2, W (Path Maker) up
theirWindow.what: He can pull you in with the Q shockwave and immediately follow with a charged W (Path Maker) stun. Back off wave or hold W (Riposte) up to parry the auto that follows the stun.

yourWindow.when: his W (Path Maker) is on cooldown (10-14s)
yourWindow.what: Walk him down and force autos. Without W he has no stun and no reduced-damage dash, so trade freely with Q (Lunge) into the double-dash proc and let E (Burst of Speed) carry your move speed to disengage clean.

start.why: Runs in 90.7% of games at 53.7% win rate — the sustained AD and self-heal off Doran's Blade lets you match his early poke through Q (Ntofo Strikes) without losing the trade war.

boots.why: 63.6% pick, 51.9% win rate — the flat physical damage reduction directly blunts his auto-attack chip damage from Q (Ntofo Strikes) and empowered All Out autos.

core.why: First item in both dominant build paths — the AD and sustain lets you win extended trades before he can stack Q for a pull.
Follows Hydra in the top build path (57% WR, 41.4% pick) — the burst of damage and move speed synergizes with E (Burst of Speed) to close gaps he tries to create with E (Footwork).
Caps the top build path (57% win rate, 263 games) — the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his All Out burst window.

situational.when: he's building toward a split-push or wave-clear stalemate, since the alternate Hydra-Trinity-Hullbreaker line (60.5% WR) rewards you sieging off the back of your lane parity
you're ahead on tempo and want to snowball burst, since Hydra-Eclipse-Endless Hunger (57.4% WR) trades some sustain for faster all-in power
their team stacks hard CC beyond K'Sante's own kit, since Mercury's Treads shows a higher 60.3% win rate in games where tenacity matters more than flat armor

runes.keystoneWhy: Runs at 53.1% win rate in the top page and rewards the exact pattern this matchup demands — repeated short trades poking around his Q (Ntofo Strikes) cooldown rather than one all-in burst window. Master-tier Fiora players instead favor Press the Attack (8,821 games) for its guaranteed burst — better if you're confident you can land a clean isolated trade before he stacks Q.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick (73.6% pick rate, 54.2% win rate) — Ignite punishes his low early sustain during Q (Ntofo Strikes) trades and secures kills once you land Q (Lunge) resets.

playing.title: Hold Riposte for the follow-up auto
playing.detail: K'Sante's real damage comes from the auto after a landed Q (Ntofo Strikes) or W (Path Maker) stun, not the ability itself. Time W (Riposte) for that auto, not the CC.

playing.title: Trade only when his Q stacks are at zero
playing.detail: At 2 stacks his Q (Ntofo Strikes) fires a shockwave that pulls you in — walking up during that window feeds him a free engage. Reset the stack by staying out of the short line hit range.

playing.title: Double-dash your Q for burst, not just gap-close
playing.detail: Q (Lunge) can be reactivated within a couple seconds at no mana cost — use both charges in a single trade window rather than saving the second for repositioning.

playing.title: Punish his charged W animation
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) requires a charge-up before the dash; if you see him start charging with no target lined up, that's 10-14 seconds of no stun coming — push the trade immediately after.

playing.title: Don't fight into a fresh All Out
playing.detail: R (All Out) knocks you back through terrain and then he transforms with increased damage and healing for the follow-up dash. If he lands the knockback, disengage rather than trading into his empowered state.

playing.title: Bank E for exit, not just chase
playing.detail: E (Burst of Speed)'s move speed stacks off landed attacks or Lunges — use it to escape his engage window around level 3-5 rather than only chasing kills.

playing.title: Save R for a clean isolated cast
playing.detail: Blade Waltz's 110-130s cooldown means one bad cast into his shield from E (Footwork) wastes your entire ultimate rotation — only commit when he has no E up to shield-cancel the burst.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reading of cooldown windows and trade patterns is our own analysis, not measured data.
